uncited: Local Ambient Occlusion methods estimate indirect illumination blocking in volume rendering by sampling local density or stochastic rays around a point, avoiding global shadow maps or precomputed buffers [4502-local-ambient-occlusion-lao.md].

Unlike siblings that rely on Signed Distance Fields [2527-ambient-occlusion-via-sdf-geometry.md] or voxel buffers [6646-voxel-ambient-occlusion.md], these techniques compute occlusion on-the-fly or via lightweight per-pixel accumulation, adapting to the volume's internal density structure [4502-local-ambient-occlusion-lao.md].
